# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probe inspects the actual GRU4Rec module through a host `ModelView`. Model implementation is not supplied; diagnosis relies on `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)` returning B × L × H states, and `predict_score(features, items)`. Final sequence representations use the maximum nonzero input position, correctly handling left padding; empty histories receive zero states.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses `view.model`, training histories, and metadata interfaces. `run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` consumes up to ten batches of `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with B × L tensors. Feature extraction uses the ModelView NumPy adapter; scoring supports final-state and per-position candidates. Execution uses inference mode, temporarily sets evaluation mode, seeds randomness to 42, then restores model mode and global RNG states.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings and maps mean pairwise cosine to [0,1]. Higher scores indicate directional alignment, not demonstrated recommendation diversity loss.
- **Sampled separation:** Measures positive-minus-negative scores at valid training positions. Reports mean, lower tenth percentile, negative-win rate, and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower failure rates indicate stronger sampled separation. Frequency strata include counts; item-category lists remain empty because metadata is unavailable.
- **Execution consistency:** Checks padding invariance, final-state selection, empty histories, finite values, scoring shapes, batching consistency, and parity with the module’s `score_candidates` entry point. Failures disable temporal interpretation.

# Perturbation & Tests

For up to 200 eligible training users, selects one training-prefix target and freezes the target plus 99 unique unseen negatives. Tests oldest/recent/random deletions, local block shuffling, final-item removal, and last-item-only histories. Reports target-rank change, HR@10 change, cosine distance, and normalized state displacement. Positive rank changes or negative HR changes indicate damage; state movement alone indicates sensitivity. Summaries include history-length and repeat/novel slices, with paired user-bootstrap intervals when sufficient observations exist.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

Returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, including denominators, execution checks, temporal user outcomes/summaries, unavailable reasons, and diagnostic runtime. Four-category macro fields remain null pending all category records. The interpreter requests concise JSON findings grounded in these measurements.

These are conditional, in-sample diagnostics, not validation gains or causal intent evidence. They do not measure simulator traits, exposure, ratings, or review text. Official macro validation HR@10 alone selects models.
